cues: Type an address and five things happen.
DNS, the internet's directory, turns the domain name into an IP address.
The browser sends an HTTP request.
The server runs any script and sends back HTML, which the browser draws.
A URL has a protocol, a domain, a path and sometimes a query string.
HTTPS is the same protocol, encrypted.
